skill.name: project-knowledge
skill.description: Loads project architecture, conventions, patterns, and gotchas so an AI assistant can understand how the repository is organized.
skill.summary: Guides AI assistants to read and apply project knowledge before making repository changes.
skill.author: Clouder0

security_audit.summary: The only static finding is a false positive caused by a fenced JSON example. No semantic security issues were found in SKILL.md; the skill limits tool use to Read and focuses on loading project knowledge.

finding_verdicts.reason: The flagged text is the opening of a fenced JSON example in SKILL.md lines 42-44, not Ruby or shell execution. The skill front matter allows only Read, and the example describes structured knowledge updates rather than commands.

content.value_statement: Project structure can be hard to follow during AI-assisted work. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to read architecture, conventions, patterns, and gotchas.
actual_capabilities: Directs the assistant to load architecture, conventions, patterns, and gotchas knowledge files.
Helps the assistant decide when project context is needed before code work.
Encourages the assistant to follow documented project patterns and conventions.
Provides a structured way to record new project discoveries after a task.
Supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows that can read local skill guidance.
limitations: It depends on the referenced knowledge files being present and accurate.
It does not analyze source files unless the assistant reads them separately.
It does not enforce conventions automatically in code.
Knowledge updates require a separate merge process after task completion.

use_cases.title: Start Work in an Existing Repository
use_cases.description: Load architecture and convention notes before changing unfamiliar code.

use_cases.title: Plan Architecture Changes
use_cases.description: Review documented structure and patterns before proposing a design change.

use_cases.title: Keep AI Coding Consistent
use_cases.description: Use project-specific patterns and gotchas while asking an assistant to implement changes.

prompt_templates.title: Load Basic Context
prompt_templates.prompt: Use project-knowledge to read the architecture and conventions files. Summarize the project structure before we edit files.

prompt_templates.title: Apply Project Patterns
prompt_templates.prompt: Use project-knowledge to read patterns and gotchas related to the area I am changing. Explain the relevant guidance before implementation.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Design Change
prompt_templates.prompt: Use project-knowledge to compare the architecture, conventions, and patterns. Create a change plan that follows the documented design.

prompt_templates.title: Capture New Knowledge
prompt_templates.prompt: Use project-knowledge after this task to identify discoveries that should become project knowledge. Propose concise updates with confidence levels.

output_examples.input: Read architecture knowledge before adding a feature.
output_examples.output: Architecture summary: the app separates interface, service, and data responsibilities. Recommended path: update the service contract first, then adjust callers.

output_examples.input: Check project patterns before changing error handling.
output_examples.output: Pattern summary: errors should use shared helpers and include actionable messages. Avoid local one-off handling unless the gotchas file explains an exception.

output_examples.input: Record something learned during this task.
output_examples.output: Suggested knowledge update: document the new dependency between the scheduling flow and notification settings. Confidence: likely.

best_practices: Load only the knowledge files relevant to the current task.
Compare project guidance with the actual code before making broad changes.
Record new discoveries with clear wording and an honest confidence level.
anti_patterns: Do not treat stale knowledge files as more reliable than current source code.
Do not apply architecture guidance to unrelated repositories.
Do not skip verification when a documented convention conflicts with implementation details.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps an AI assistant load project structure, conventions, patterns, and gotchas before repository work.

faq.question: Does it run commands?
faq.answer: No. The skill declares Read as its allowed tool and provides guidance for reading project knowledge files.

faq.question: Can it update files automatically?
faq.answer: No. It describes a knowledge update format, but merging updates happens after task completion.

faq.question: Who should use it?
faq.answer: It is useful for developers, maintainers, and AI coding workflows that need repository-specific context.

faq.question: Does it replace code review?
faq.answer: No. It provides context, but users should still review code changes and verify assumptions.

faq.question: Which assistants can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
